# 片刻 離線名片 (Pianke)

> 片刻 離線名片 (English name: Pianke) is a business card scanner app for Android and iPhone / iPad that works entirely offline. Scanning, OCR, organizing and export all happen on the phone: no account, no cloud upload, no ads, no tracking. The Android app requests no internet permission; the iOS app contains no networking code. Free to download (up to 15 cards); Pro is a one-time purchase (NT$490 / US$14.99, not a subscription).

Search the stores for 「片刻 離線名片」. Note: an unrelated travel-journal app is also called 「片刻」; this one is the business card scanner by Pianke.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Android 8.0+ (Google Play, package com.pianke.cardscanner); iPhone / iPad on iOS 17+ (App Store id6813446077)
- Recognition: on-device OCR for Chinese and English business cards; works in airplane mode
- Privacy: no account, no upload, no ads, no analytics; cards are stored only on the device
- Export: vCard (phone contacts, Google / Outlook), CSV (Excel, CRM); encrypted backup files move between Android and iPhone
- Pro (one-time purchase): unlimited cards, batch scanning, two-sided cards, PDF + CSV visit reports grouped by company or date (the free version can produce a watermarked report preview)
- Built for: salespeople and anyone who collects cards at trade shows and client visits and must not upload client data to a cloud
